description.label: Description
description.value: Language (Battle) Test related to this Talent The Almogavar Battlecry, cemented during the Battle of Magritta when an Almogavar Compañia held the left flank alone against insurmountable odds. Soldiers new and old fall back to this chant to renew their vigour, perhaps not ensuring victory, but providing a second wind. Once per Encounter, as a Free Action, the Almogavar can attempt a Challenging (+0) Language (Battle) Test during combat to earn Advantage per +SL up to their Initiative Bonus.
